no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not deemed necessary for this application because no review issues were identified that raised significant public health questions regarding the risk: benefit assessment of pralsetinib for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for GAVRETO (pralsetinib, NDA213721). The Multidisciplinary Review states an AC meeting was not deemed necessary because no review issues raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee concern-to-change linkages.
